description: S59 T6 (EV7): secretref.create takes a NAME, a SOURCE KIND and a SOURCE — the three things that say where a value lives — plus what the child will call it (injectAs, which defaults to the name and must be a variable name, refused as inject-as-shape otherwise). No key in this params bag can hold a value, and the refusal of one happens at the door. `origin` is `user` because a door cannot claim the system's, and `referencedBy` starts empty: a reference exists before any environment uses it, which is how a person stages a secret before wiring it.
